problem: A dedicated editor was followed by a second generated editor for the same setting, including repeated profile and order-flow toggles.
fix: Dedicated setting ownership suppresses only the repeated generated controls. Slider plus matching numeric input remain one logical control. Catalogue IDs and legacy aliases are unique.

problem: Shared palette colour changes could save while useThemeColors continued to override them.
fix: Selecting a custom colour disables theme mode and seeds sibling theme colours; the main editor uses one set of individual controls. Schemes disable individual controls and the theme toggle while they own the colours.

problem: Cumulative Delta Histogram exposed lineColor even though the later plot-colour pass overrode it.
fix: Removed the redundant default/UI field. The main plot colour controls the line; bars/candles keep their separate Ask/Bid colours. Existing stored compatibility data is retained.

problem: Filtered-CVD, average/deviation, smoothing, regression and reversal inputs looked usable when their parent calculation was disabled.
fix: Inactive controls show their actual dependency and disable until that mode/plot is active. Gated fixtures prove enabled filter/average/smoothing settings alter their intended output.

problem: Flattened settings fragments reused React child key .0, risking reused, omitted or duplicated controls across tab updates.
fix: Section entries now retain unique hierarchical React identities. All 124 final rendered dialogs have zero console errors.

problem: The configured owned cash quote path supplies no traded volume or aggressor-side executions. All ten stock/ETF recordings captured in the preceding Volume audit contained volume 0; cash indices have no traded underlying volume. VXN is not on the configured live path. Price-only studies can use supplied OHLC. Volume, delta, footprint, tape and depth cannot be manufactured from quotes.
fix: No replacement feed purchased, polling added, or missing data invented.

problem: Closed market: no live exchange session was observed for this audit.
fix: Delivery hooks and execution coalescing were exercised with controlled events. This does not establish current exchange latency or continuous recording completeness.

problem: Owned minute aggregates do not reconstruct subminute execution paths, exact footprint rows or depth. Some generic calculations use a bounded lightweight history window.
fix: All supported interval builders were tested with synthetic execution inputs; recorded OHLCV was checked separately. No provider history backfill or false completeness claim.

problem: 22 of 123 dedicated suites fail; all 22 reproduce on untouched HEAD. Three additional support-suite failures also reproduce there.
fix: Documented exact results and reasons; did not alter functionality to satisfy obsolete source-string/theme/default assertions. The 8 ms computation budget failure remains a performance concern, not a waiver.
